Overview

Maturín is a city in N with a population of 500,000. The capital of Venezuela’s oil-rich Monagas state, a hot city surrounded by oil fields and tropical savanna. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7b growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 30.0.
